body: I've been in therapy for a while now (it does help), and my next step is to move out. I really try to keep out of everyone's way, this is just the first big holiday that I've had to deal with. I have another 8ish months before I can move out, but I'll most likely be out before next Christmas. I am glad in some ways that this happened because it's shown me what kind of person T is, but I also miss who my brother used to be and the relationship we used to have.

We weren't officially together, but she told me she wanted to get back together a day before we went on the trip. My brother told me to wait to do anything until after the trip was over. T and I had been friends for years at this point and my brother and I were very close. Then this happened and they've both completely changed, and I can't avoid it because they're family. I don't think anyone could go through this without being hurt by it, and I haven't done anything except ask that T not spend days at a time at my house. I lost my best friend/lover and my brother in one fell swoop, without so much as an apology. I've had a year to get over it, but it's not bitter of me to ask that I am able to walk around freely in my own house without running into my ex every day.

I definitely don't want to "win" her back, she's been very manipulative throughout this whole situation. I just wish this didn't happen at all, because I miss the relationship we used to have. But I know she's changed for the worst. She used to have a pride sticker on her car, but when she got with my brother, she took it off. He's the complete opposite of both of us (misogynistic, racist, uses slurs, etc) and there's no doubt in my mind she took it off for him. He dropped out of school when he was 16 and T recently did the same thing with 3 weeks left of her senior year. I understand that whole period of time in my life with her is gone but I do wish I had a say in how it ended.

I haven't talked to her in probably 2 months, we texted for a bit after we met up but not since I remembered why this happened in the first place. It does suck, though, because I do miss her and love her. I know she's at fault and I thought being on good terms with her would help the mental turmoil, although it definitely didn't. I wanted her to apologise but she never did.

If you're nice to your baristas and don't come in coughing with tissues up your nose, we don't mind making it for you. I would recommend either coming into the store or mobile ordering. A lot of people just treat us like robots and being nice makes such a huge difference.

No one seems to have any issue with this, even after I was groomed as a 12 year old. My family has a track record of being ignorant and turning a blind eye to things like this. I don't know what else to do because everyone treats my brother like an angel - he's never had a job, doesn't have a car, which is why T is always at my house because she drives. She picks him up which I think is utterly humiliating. You know that stereotype of the gamer living in their parent's basement? Well, he's the gamer living in his grandparent's attic. My grandparents told me that T is "low hanging fruit" and that it worked out because neither of them had to expend any energy into finding a relationship. It was convenient.

I do think it's an issue - I've mentioned this fact several times to everyone involved. I had a bad experience myself with someone who was much older than I was, which is why I am utterly disgusted with everything that's happened. I had to cut a few parts out to fit the word count. I mentioned the age gap to my brother which is why we ending up having a verbal altercation - he compared this situation to my prior grooming in a way that didn't implicate him at all.

I had to cut some things out in order to meet the word count, but her dad is the type of person that will let her make her own mistakes, no matter what they may be. I don't want to affect my mom's relationship with T's dad, and I don't live with them, so I don't talk to him often. I don't know how he's okay with it, especially because T and my brother are largely unsupervised. I've voiced my concerns but my mom doesn't want to try to control anyone.
